faqsData.question: What is the average turnaround time between applying and client interviews?
faqsData.answer: Our talent acquisition directors review incoming candidate profiles within 24 to 48 hours. Pre-screened candidates typically receive direct interview routing with client VPs of Engineering within 3 to 5 business days.

faqsData.question: Does ThinkWires deduct any commission or placement fees from my salary?
faqsData.answer: No, 100% free for candidates. All recruitment, technical vetting, and placement advisory costs are funded entirely by enterprise client partners.

faqsData.question: Can I transition from a contract or C2H role to a full-time position?
faqsData.answer: Yes! Over 80% of our contract and Contract-to-Hire (C2H) placements convert to permanent full-time employment within 6 to 12 months based on mutual performance evaluations.

faqsData.question: How does ThinkWires handle cross-border payments for Remote US/Canada roles?
faqsData.answer: We manage end-to-end Employer of Record (EOR) operations, handling multi-currency salary disbursements, local tax compliance, health insurance, and statutory benefits with zero hassle.
